Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • With two displays, the "What's New" window now opens over the mail window on the same display, instead of sometimes on the other screen.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Quick reply. Every conversation now has a reply box at the bottom. Type and press ⌘Return or Send. You still get the few seconds to undo, and undoing opens your reply in a full compose window. Switch between Reply and Reply All with the arrow button on the left, or move to a full compose window with the expand button.
  • Reply from notifications. New-mail notifications now have Reply and Mark as Read buttons, so you can answer without opening Normal Mail.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • ⌘K searches everything. Press ⌘K (or ⌥⌘F) to search all mail in every account, not just the list you're viewing. ⌘F and / still search the current list. When you clear the search, you're back where you were. While you're writing a message, ⌘K still inserts a link.
  • The subject stays in view. In a long conversation, a slim bar with the subject stays at the top as you scroll. Click it to jump back to the top.
